subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI device tokens collide across same-origin gateway paths

question: Should the legacy origin-wide browser device-auth record be migrated to the first gateway opened after upgrade, or should upgrade force fresh scoped device credentials for each endpoint?
rationale: The old record stores a bearer device credential without endpoint provenance, so the migration choice affects both upgrade continuity and cross-gateway credential isolation.

options.title: Accept first-open migration
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR's endpoint-scoped storage and claim the ambiguous legacy record once before deleting the old key.

options.title: Force fresh scoped credentials
options.body: Discard the ambiguous legacy record on upgrade and require each gateway endpoint to issue a new scoped device token.

recommendation.title: Accept first-open migration
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR's endpoint-scoped storage and claim the ambiguous legacy record once before deleting the old key.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Control UI device-auth history and current storage/auth paths trace most strongly to this owner signal.
